import pandas as pd, re
ben = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
pay = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', header=4)
pay['Beneficiary ID'] = pay['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
ben['Beneficiary ID'] = ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
pay['Status'] = pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# clean amount
def clean_amt(x):
    if pd.isna(x): return None
    s=str(x)
    s=re.sub(r'["'^'"\\d.]','', s)
    return int(float(s)) if s else None
pay['Amount_clean']=pay['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amt)
pay_paid=pay[pay['Status']=='paid']
merged=pay_paid.merge(ben, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
mask=(merged['Programme'].str.strip()=='Girls\\\\' Education') & (merged['State'].str.strip().str.lower()=='odisha')
filtered=merged[mask]
total=filtered['Amount_clean'].sum()
print('Rows',len(filtered))
print(total)
print(filtered[['Beneficiary ID','State','Programme','Amount_clean']].head())
\"
"
